lessons.lesson: Bug: mean() function divided by (len(values) + 1) instead of len(values). This off-by-one error caused incorrect mean calculations. For [2,4,6], it returned 3.0 instead of 4. For [9], it returned 4.5 instead of 9. Fix: Changed denominator from (len(values) + 1) to len(values). Tests: 3/3 passed after fix.
